Satellite constellation for internet of things called Telum Leo 1.
Description

the satellite constellation will include 144 main spacecraft and 8 reserve ones. The width of the face of the device is 10 cm, height - 3.4 cm, weight - 1.5 kg, solar battery power - 8 W. The first experimental satellites are due to be launched in December 2023, Urlicic said.
